title: Malaysia and related scholarship on farḍ kifāya, formation, institutions and ḥadd al-kifāyah
scope_note: Includes Malaysian scholarship, Malaysian-published articles with non-Malaysian contributors, and an international academy resolution adopted in Putrajaya; not all are Malaysian-authored.
distinction: ḥadd al-kifāyah is a welfare/zakat adequacy threshold and is different from farḍ kifāya, a collective legal duty.

studies.title: Human Resource Development in the Muslim World
studies.authors_and_venue: International Islamic Fiqh Academy · 18th session, Putrajaya, Malaysia
studies.research_contribution: Establishes a comprehensive model of human capacities—physical, intellectual, psychological and spiritual—and calls for competent leadership, integrated curricula, research, and useful sciences connected to communal needs.
studies.qualification_or_limit: A resolution of an international academy meeting in Malaysia, not an independently authored Malaysian empirical study; broad collective principles do not establish any particular local deficiency.

studies.title: The Delights of Knowledge
studies.authors_and_venue: Mohd Sani Badron · Institute of Islamic Understanding Malaysia (IKIM)
studies.research_contribution: Explains al-Ghazālī’s range of essential sciences and reports al-Attas’s extension of communal learning to the human sciences, technical sciences, comparative religion and civilisational studies.
studies.qualification_or_limit: An explanatory institutional essay, not a new fatwa or proof that every listed discipline is presently undersupplied.

studies.title: Konsep Ilmu Fardu Ain dan Fardu Kifayah dan Kepentingan Amalannya dalam Kurikulum Pendidikan Islam
studies.authors_and_venue: Mukhlas Nugraha · TAFHIM, IKIM Journal of Islam and the Contemporary World
studies.research_contribution: Studies the relation between personally obligatory and communally obligatory knowledge in educational curricula, including human purpose and the changing practical requirements of knowledge.
studies.qualification_or_limit: Published in a Malaysian journal but authored by a scholar affiliated with an Indonesian university; its abstract does not establish the effectiveness of a particular new curriculum.

studies.title: The Importance of Agriculture and Its Role in Food Sovereignty
studies.authors_and_venue: Rizky Febrian and Sarif Hidayatullah · TAFHIM (IKIM)
studies.research_contribution: Examines al-Ḥubayshī on agricultural work, self-reliance and food sovereignty, presenting an argument for agriculture’s communal importance.
studies.qualification_or_limit: This is a textual argument about agriculture, not evidence that every locality is obliged to produce all its own food; compare alternative supply and trade arguments.

studies.title: National Collective Responsibility (Farḍ Kifāyah) and Its Relationship with the Purposes of Shariah
studies.authors_and_venue: Mahamed Fathy Eletrebi, Hassan Suleiman, Walīd Mohamed Abdelrahman · IIUM repository
studies.research_contribution: Directly examines how collective responsibilities relate to Islamic legal objectives and national organisation; it can inform the identification of responsible institutions.
studies.qualification_or_limit: Repository access to the full paper is restricted; only catalogue metadata and abstract were checked for this edition.

studies.title: Lifelong Learning Education for Fardhu ʿAyn Skill and Knowledge: The Bustan ʿIlm Project
studies.authors_and_venue: Raudlotul Firdaus Fatah Yasin · Al-Turath / CENTRIS IIUM
studies.research_contribution: Studies continuing education for older Muslims through a specific IIUM programme and argues for learning that serves spiritual preparation across the life course.
studies.qualification_or_limit: The learners’ knowledge is principally farḍ ʿayn; provision of teaching capacity is a separate institutional question. The study does not itself show a widespread teacher shortage.
studies.method: Qualitative study; interviews and thematic analysis

studies.title: Empowering Mosque Institutions as Local Economic Aid Centers in Malaysia
studies.authors_and_venue: Muhammad Najib Abd Wakil, Azman Ab Rahman, Ahmad Syukran Baharuddin · Journal of Fatwa Management and Research
studies.research_contribution: Uses documents and interviews to investigate how mosques facilitate economic support, including zakat, waqf and other resources, and proposes a locally administered assistance model.
studies.qualification_or_limit: Qualitative examination of selected institutions, not a nationwide causal evaluation or evidence that mosque construction is always a collective obligation.

studies.title: MASA@Sungai Nibong: Holistic Urban-Poverty Intervention
studies.authors_and_venue: Mohd Sadiq Mohd Mokhtar, Shereeza Mohamed Saniff, Ahmad Shaifful Anuar Ahmad Shukor · Jurnal Islam dan Masyarakat Kontemporari
studies.research_contribution: Studies a phased project involving households in waqf accommodation in Penang. The authors report improved household incomes, women’s economic participation and reduced dependence on assistance through tailored guidance and entrepreneurship.
studies.qualification_or_limit: A context-specific qualitative case study; reported improvements are not an independently established general treatment effect.
studies.method: Qualitative case study and content analysis

studies.title: Penilaian Ḥadd al-Kifāyah Berasaskan Maqāṣid al-Sharīʿah
studies.authors_and_venue: Abdul Muzil Abd Rahim · Universiti Kebangsaan Malaysia
studies.research_contribution: Examines poverty and zakat eligibility thresholds across Malaysian jurisdictions and recommends attention to religious learning, preventive healthcare, participation and human development alongside material costs.
studies.qualification_or_limit: Ḥadd al-kifāyah is a threshold of household sufficiency in poverty/zakat administration; it is not equivalent to the legal category farḍ kifāya.
studies.method: Thesis; case-study analysis and four expert interviews
